identity.notes: The official contact page, official-linked SpotOn storefront, exact-address Uber Eats catalog, and active DC restaurant alcohol license independently bind the current business to 1529 Wisconsin Ave NW. The main dining room and upstairs Cottage Speakeasy are service areas of this one restaurant.

sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies Cottage House Ethiopian Cuisine in Georgetown, links the main and speakeasy menus, and links the live SpotOn ordering storefront.
Official contact page lists 1529 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC 20007, phone (202) 891-7875, daily Cottage House hours, and separate Cottage Speakeasy hours.

Current official main menu supplies appetizers, beef/lamb, chicken, vegetarian, combination, fish, pasta/rice, dessert, and nonalcoholic beverage sections with ingredient descriptions. Paired protein and tea choices were resolved against exact ordering presentations.
Current official Cottage Speakeasy menu lists ten food products plus Heineken 00; alcohol-only drinks were excluded.

Live SpotOn storefront linked by the official homepage identifies Cottage House Ethiopian Cuisine and exposes a complete current pickup catalog across appetizers, beef/lamb, beverages, brunch, chicken, desserts, fish, pasta, vegetarian/vegan, combinations, and coffee beans. Duplicate sparkling-water and coffee-bean placements were consolidated.

Fresh exact-address marketplace catalog identifies 1529 Wisconsin Avenue, Washington, DC 20007 as open and corroborates main, speakeasy, brunch, nonalcoholic beer, and four current kids products. Repeated promotion and happy-hour placements were consolidated; alcohol was excluded.
DC ABCA issuance report lists Cottage House Ethiopian Cuisine, DDT LLC, at 1529 Wisconsin Avenue NW with active restaurant license ABRA-133399 through March 31, 2028.
Fresh official-domain and downloadable-document searches found the current HTML menus but no restaurant-issued allergen matrix, nutrition guide, ingredient guide, or cross-contact document.
Exact-brand and exact-location searches corroborated the official and marketplace surfaces and found no authoritative item-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.

findings.summary: Official, government, official-linked ordering, and exact-address marketplace sources agree on the active Cottage House Ethiopian Cuisine at 1529 Wisconsin Ave NW; the Cottage Speakeasy is an upstairs service area of the same business.

The current food and nonalcoholic boundary contains 100 consolidated products, versus the frozen ten-item speakeasy slice. Main dining, brunch, beverages, kids, and other categories were missing; repeated categories, promotion placements, provider typos, and paired presentations were normalized.

No comprehensive item-by-allergen matrix or restaurant-level cross-contact policy was found after all four searches. Current ingredient descriptions support only selected direct positive claims; unsupported negatives and may-contain inferences were excluded.
